entities.summary: Manuel Ganahl is an Austrian professional ice hockey forward currently playing for EC KAC of the ICE Hockey League (ICEHL). Ganahl previously played with Graz 99ers before signing a two-year contract with Klagenfurt as an impending free agent on 23 March 2015.
